title: Hausa Language Technologies in the Age of Artificial Intelligence: A Systematic Review of Resources, Applications, Challenges, and Research Gaps (corpus and protocol)
description: Complete machine-readable artifacts of a study-selection 2020-reported systematic review of Hausa language technology, following a curated-corpus methodology: version 1 of the corpus (250 quota-structured publications across eight thematic areas), the per-record scope-screening and retrieval log (version 1 reduced to a 29-study direct-contribution core; a 159-record completion register and a scripted retrieval run of 5 October 2026 added the remaining studies), the final 153-study inventory with per-study insights and bibliographic quality scores, a 41-resource catalogue, the fixed data-extraction form, study-selection flow counts, an evidence-to-gap matrix for gaps G1-G10, a categorical-claim audit log, and the LaTeX source of the review paper.
